extraction.Name: Earnest Charbonneau (Dec'd)
extraction.NOTES: Deponent is Alexis M. Charbonneau, age 80, father of Earnest Charbonneau; Earnest died April 5th, 1931, two years after receiving the fee patent; he was not married at the time of sale or at death; sold land for $5000 in cash and one half section of land closer to his home, and sold that half section for $1300 cash; notary public for Cherry County, Nebraska; commission expires April 17th, 1930; document sworn June 4, 1939
